visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a bright, modern cafe in Shibuya, Tokyo. A large, circular white table dominated by a pool of water and a central island of artificial green grass sits in the foreground. A rock-like structure serves as a fountain, dripping water into the table's basin. (2) A close-up shot shows a hand dipping fingers into the clear water, creating ripples. The surrounding city buildings are visible through large glass windows in the background. (3) Two dark, jagged desserts resembling lava stones are shown resting in the water near the table's edge. A wooden spoon cuts into one, revealing a soft, charcoal-black interior. (4) A glass bowl containing a white spherical dessert is presented. A hand pours thick, vibrant green matcha liquid over it from a ceramic pitcher, creating a swirling visual effect. (5) Shots of a paper menu and information cards are held up by a hand, detailing prices and cafe rules. The cafe is populated with a few patrons sitting in the background. (6) The video concludes with a wide shot of the unique cafe interior and a final close-up of the rock-shaped dessert being handled.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 快收藏起來. (2) [Subtitle]: 這是一家位於澀谷新開的 RURU SHIBUYA. (3) [Subtitle]: 這不是什麼高檔的流水席. (4) [Subtitle]: 整片水面的桌子微波蕩漾. (5) [Subtitle]: 兩顆宛如石頭的甜點靜靜的在飄. (6) [Subtitle]: 左邊是漆黑菱角的熔岩石. [Subtitle]: 其實是竹炭起司蛋糕. (7) [Subtitle]: 外層看起來是清脆. [Subtitle]: 但其實它是柔軟又綿密的. (8) [Subtitle]: 店員會端著碗. [Subtitle]: 然後現場幫你澆一下濃綠的瀑布. (9) [Subtitle]: 這個綠色的光澤立刻延蔓出來. [Subtitle]: 畫面非常療癒. (10) [Subtitle]: 甜點師傅把竹炭乳酪還有宇治抹茶配方標準的調配到位. (11) [Subtitle]: 而且口感層次比外型更加驚喜. (12) [Slogan]: 1000塊日元. (13) [Subtitle]: 搭配抹茶或者是烘焙拿鐵. (14) [Subtitle]: 還有它桌邊秀絕對是打卡拍照的好地方. (15) [Subtitle]: 不過提醒大家. [Subtitle]: 店員規定每個人至少要點一個甜點還有一個飲料. (16) [Subtitle]: 想要拍照記得要提早卡位. (17) [Subtitle]: 你想要竹炭黑的熔岩石還是黑苔. [Subtitle]: 留言告訴我你的選擇. (18) [Subtitle]: 我把地址寫在下方.
